findings.issue: The doctest on `register_scripted_backends` is not gated on `test-util`. The module compiles under `cfg(any(test, feature = "test-util"))`, but a doctest links the library built with `cfg(test)` off. A plain `cargo test -p sc-jev-check` therefore leaves `register_scripted_backends` undefined and the doctest fails to compile. Under `--workspace`, feature unification hides this.
findings.recommendation: Gate the example with a doc-level `cfg_attr(not(feature = "test-util"), doc = ...)` or mark it `ignore`. Alternatively, accept that every validation line must pass `--features test-util`, as the README convention says, and state that in the sprint validation lines.
findings.evidence: registry/mod.rs lines 23-31 gate the module; the doctest in scripted.rs lines 38-51 has no gate. sc-jev-check has no `[[test]] required-features` or doctest setting for this.
